title: Guneku Agro CIG opens its farm to buyers
excerpt: Our Agro CIG has opened its farm to buyers. Its manager, a professional veterinarian, showed the chickens, chicks, ducks, pigs and manure on offer, and said the layers should begin laying around December.
sourceNote: Written fresh on 17 October 2026 from the Fondom Studios video published on Facebook on 16 October 2026 and its caption. What is listed is what the CIG advertised in that video; it is not an independent count of stock. The order number is the one the CIG published for enquiries and orders. Rewritten 17 October 2026. Order number verified against the video caption ('For enquiries and orders, call: 673 536 278'); not independently tested as operational, and not confirmed directly with the Delegate.
body:
Six months after its launch at Ngong Quarter, our Guneku Agro Common Initiative Group has opened its farm to buyers. On 16 October 2026 the CIG's manager, a professional veterinarian, walked the Fondom Studios camera round the site and showed what the farm now offers.

On offer

  • Chickens for occasions.
  • Young chicks for anyone who wants to raise their own.
  • Ducks, known locally as duck fowl.
  • Pigs, which were still a plan when the CIG launched in April.
  • Manure at an affordable price, so that our farmers no longer need to go to Bamenda for it.

The layers are expected to start laying eggs around December 2026. Stock changes from week to week, so call ahead to check what is available.

Orders and enquiries

The CIG takes orders and enquiries on 673 536 278, the number it announced in the video.

Everything else about the CIG, from its registration and membership to how it is run, is on the Guneku Agro CIG page. Watch the farm tour by Fondom Studios: Guneku Agro CIG on Facebook.
